svg.title: Evaluate both ordinary and shifted synthetic images
svg.desc: Confusion counts on 40 independent synthetic test images and fixed-model accuracy as the same test masks lose contrast. The dashed line is 0.5 for balanced labels, not a clinical reference. The weights and class centers are never refit to these tests.
